dimension.meaning: finite technical representation, not a field topology or termination limit

max_steps.rule: Never infer or auto-fill a count. It may be supplied only when the user explicitly requests a bounded technical test.

step.meaning: state transition representation, not a required step count or scalar result

timeout_s.rule: Infrastructure watchdog is service-managed and outside the declared reality.

npz_transport.rule: Every named array must exactly declare name, dtype, shape and semantic; object arrays and unknown manifest fields are rejected.

result_semantics: Preparation writes immutable input evidence. Confirmed run is selected by private CML; direct conflicts are eliminated before CML_A, otherwise CML_A processes the numeric state-symbol slice. A result certificate references the input certificate after a returned state event.

termination.watchdog_boundary: An infrastructure interruption yields a technical unresolved event, never proof of impossibility.
